'''2025 Retro Invitational Player's Ball''' was a 16-player, invite-only [[Match Play]] tournament played on [[GEMP]] from 2 November to 20 December 2025. It was the first Retro Invitational Player's Ball.<ref name="announce">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86095 2025 Retro Invitational Player's Ball], andytalaga1, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 October 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152206/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86095.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Timo Dusel]] defeated [[Patrick Johnson]] in the Finals.<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI SWCCG CNVM: 2025 Invitational Deck Techs and Game Analysis from the Event Winner], BillBisco2, YouTube (1 February 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012142507/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' Classic No V (Modified): no virtual cards, plus the [[Reflections III]] Defensive Shields and their Starting Effects. No other cards were banned.<ref name="announce" />
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Tournament organizer:''' [[Andy Talaga]]<ref name="announce" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 November – 20 December 2025
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1575 2025 Retro Invitational Player's Ball forum]
* '''Video:''' [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hbi3fs0mvrI Timo Dusel's deck techs and bracket games] (with GEMP replays)<ref name="video" />

Players were drawn at random into four pods of four. Each pod played three rounds of round robin, ranked by victory points and total differential. The top two players in each pod advanced to a single-elimination Top 8; the bottom two played a consolation bracket. Each player had a 40-minute clock and a 5-minute inaction timer. One deck per side was locked for the pods (due 31 October); players could submit new decks for the bracket (due 28 November).<ref name="announce" />

== Participants ==

[[Andy Talaga]], [[Joe Horbey]], [[Jonny Chu]], [[Benji Chu]], [[Eddie Szwabowski]], [[Matt Fendt|Matthew Fendt]], [[Ian Monteith]], [[Brad Kippel]], [[Timo Dusel]], [[Patrick Lima]], [[Matthew Ford]], [[David Garcia]], [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]], [[Will Tarbox]], [[Paul Todd Feldman|Paul Feldman]] and [[Andrew Bethell]].<ref name="announce" />
